INITIALIZATION

```{r setup libraries, importing csv, factorizing necessary variables }
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)
library(labelled)
library(ResourceSelection)
library(pROC)
library(plyr)

# import excel workbook
state_data <- read_excel("C:/easy/mat430_working_data11-30.xlsx",sheet="all_data_sans_dc")

# convert necessary vars to factor
sdata <- within(state_data, {
  loc <- factor(loc)
  mand_attend_age <- factor(mand_attend_age)
  dist_req_k_offered <- factor(dist_req_k_offered)
  k_attend_req <- factor(k_attend_req)
  knowledge_exam <- factor(knowledge_exam)
  teaching_skill_exam <- factor(teaching_skill_exam)
})

# data check
head(sdata, 10)

```

```{r function def correlation matrix gen }
# similar to last code block but smarter frames...

#and a function wrapper to speed things along

generate_plots <- function(seed){ #seed is frame to plot
  #outer loop controls x var in correlation plots
  for (xvar in seed) {
    #inner loop plots var as x against all other vars in frame
    for (yvar in seed) {
      if(!setequal(xvar,yvar)){
        plot(xvar,yvar, xlab = var_label(xvar),ylab = var_label(yvar))
        abline(lm(yvar~xvar))
      }
    }
  } 
}

```

```{r function def for assessing lm performance}

assess_lm<-function(model){
  print(summary(model))
  
  fitted_values <- fitted.values(model)
  residuals <- residuals(model)
  
  # histogram of residuals 
  # adapted from https://www.statology.org/histogram-of-residuals-in-r/
  #FIXME WHY U NO SHOW UP HUH???
  # ggplot(data = sdata, aes(x = residuals)) +
  #   geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = 'grey', color = 'black') +
  #   labs(title = 'Histogram of Residuals', x = 'Residuals', y = 'Frequency')
  
  #histogram of residuals
  hist(residuals)
  
  # Plot residuals v. fitted
  plot(fitted_values, residuals, 
       main = "Residuals against Fitted Values",
       xlab = "Fitted Values", ylab = "Residuals",
       col="blue")
  
  # Q-Q normal plot
  qqnorm(residuals, pch = 19, col="blue", frame = FALSE)
  qqline(residuals, col = "red", lwd = 2)
}

```

```{r nested_lm_pol}
###
# list of nested models for anova
###

ppe1 <- lm (per_ba ~ teacher_pay, 
                 data = sdata)

ppe2 <- lm (per_ba ~ teacher_pay + pup_teach_ratio,
                 data = sdata)

ppe3 <- lm (per_ba ~ teacher_pay + pup_teach_ratio + dem_rep_ratio_20, 
                 data = sdata)

ppe4 <- lm (per_ba ~ teacher_pay + pup_teach_ratio + dem_rep_ratio_20 + 
                   min_hours_by8th, data = sdata)

ppe5 <- lm (per_ba ~ teacher_pay + pup_teach_ratio + dem_rep_ratio_20 + 
                   min_hours_by8th + teaching_skill_exam,
                 data = sdata)

ppe7 <- lm (per_ba ~ teacher_pay + pup_teach_ratio + dem_rep_ratio_20 + 
                   min_hours_by8th + mand_attend_age, 
                 data = sdata)


```
